IF FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES OR FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES: the two flags are set only at 1136 and 1174, inside 1220-EDIT-TYPECD and 1230-EDIT-DESC, which 1200-EDIT-INPUTS performs after 1210-EDIT-ARRAY; WS-MISC-STORAGE is fresh every task and holds no VALUE for them, so neither flag is 'Y' when 1210 runs and the true arm cannot be taken. Assumption: storage without a VALUE clause starts as spaces or low-values.
IF FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID: the only way past the blank test at 1147-1148 is the ELSE at 1151 that SETs FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID (1152), and nothing runs between, so the flag is always valid here.

WHEN WS-IN-TYPE-CD = 0: WS-IN-TYPE-CD is PIC X(02) and the literal 0 has one digit, so IBM (numeric integer literal against an alphanumeric item: the literal is compared as the alphanumeric '0', the shorter operand padded with spaces) and cobc both compare it with '0 ', never with '00'; the case's type-filter-zeros scenario ('00') runs and does not take the arm. '0 ' is not NUMERIC, so 1220-EDIT-TYPECD sets FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK, which the earlier WHEN (1450-1451) takes; spaces, low-values and a valid two-digit code never equal '0 ' or reach this WHEN.

EVALUATE TRUE (OTHER): the arm before it, WHEN WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE (1550), is true for every input that reaches it: 2000-SEND-MAP performs 2100-SCREEN-INIT (SET WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE at 1320) before 2500-SETUP-MESSAGE, and WS-INFO-MSG is written only in 2500 itself and at 1859/1912 (PF10 paths that send the map afterwards, taking the first WHENs of this EVALUATE), so the message is blank whenever an unmatched input falls through.

IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE (PF8 WHEN at 1541): 2100-SCREEN-INIT sets WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE at 1320 earlier in the same 2000-SEND-MAP and no WHEN of 2500's EVALUATE runs before the one selected, so the message is blank on entry and the false arm cannot be taken.

IF CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN AND CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS (PF8 WHEN at 1541): the WHEN already holds CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS, so the false arm needs CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN, but the earlier WHEN (1536-1538: PF8, next page not exists, last page shown) takes every such input first.

IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE: WS-INFO-MSG is written only at 1320 (blank), 1508-1554 (2500-SETUP-MESSAGE, under 2000-SEND-MAP) and this paragraph; 9200-UPDATE-RECORD is performed from the PF10 WHEN of 0000-MAIN before any 2000-SEND-MAP in the task, and WS-MISC-STORAGE is fresh each task, so the message is still blank (SPACES or LOW-VALUES, both in WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE) and the false arm cannot be taken. Assumption: storage without a VALUE clause starts as spaces or low-values.
